'''Grilled sea cucumbers in a blanket''' was an [[Foodstuff/Legends|hors d'oeuvre]] dish. It was served at the annual [[Vor-cal Feast]] held aboard the [[House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vycinyth]].<ref name="LE" />
